_note: Per-source access policy for requests the nightly makes outside the shared defaults. Each entry states host, paths, identity, rate, retry, window, budget, licence and answer_mode. tests/test_source_policy.py holds the code to these values. Approved 16 Nov 2026 (bill sources hub ruling b); see docs/SOURCES-ACCESS.md.

rate.basis: www.legislation.gov.au robots.txt Crawl-delay 10; the API host has no robots file

retry.refusal: pause (exit 4), keep the last good rows

window.rule: requests only 20:00 to 08:00 in both zones; never retried inside busy hours

frl_acts.attribution: Based on content from the Federal Register of Legislation at {full date of download}. For the latest information on Australian Government legislation please go to https://www.legislation.gov.au.
frl_acts.attribution_where: wherever an FRL-sourced date appears: the bill page, the bill edition, Ask and MCP record text

rate.basis: robots honoured; a 404 robots file means no rules

oa_hansard_xml.attribution: Commonwealth of Australia (Hansard) and the OpenAustralia Foundation; link the XML file and the original ParlInfo URL
oa_hansard_xml.use: bill readings by the exact <bills> official id only; an exact title match goes to review, never to a page

tvfy.note: help pages served a Cloudflare challenge to the identifying agent on 16 Nov 2026; the API was not tested. Fallback only; no challenge is ever solved.
